_why_punch_in_aim: maxWELL's edit shows the settled aim as an editor punch-in: a still, magnified crop of the aim view with a red circle drawn on the crosshair reference. It is followed by only 3-4 live, unzoomed frames at 24fps with the ability raised before release. That leaves no live aim longer than 0.17s, under merge_spans' 0.25s clip floor. The rows below open AIM onto the punch-in's last frames. The punch-in is the same aim with the author's reference marked, never a different view. Every AIM clip therefore shows the circled reference, then the live frames through release. Measured with frames.sh (frame-exact).
_why_side_view_landing: On this source a FLASH/drive pop is filmed from a second angle after a hard cut. There is no whiteout: the deploy is a yellow-white sphere with radial rays that grows, peaks and fades in about 0.3-0.4s. The localizer pinned only the peak (0.17-0.2s). The rows below cover the burst from first bloom to fade, measured frame-exact.
_why_excluded: Two flash rows show no deploy on camera at all (see each reason), so no override can repair them.
